newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Cty, Pa., to vote on amending government.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Cty, Pa., to vote on amending government.

text.p: Pennsylvania Gov. Tom Ridge has signed legislation placing a question on the November ballot for Allegheny County residents, asking whether the county's governing structure should be altered.
The proposal, dubbed "Allegheny 2000," would replace the current system of a three-member governing committee with a county executive and part-time council.
